push.title: Daily reminders
push.intro: One gentle notification a day, at the hour you choose, so you don't forget the 3 minutes of play.
push.consent: If you turn reminders on, we keep on the Ludiko server only: the technical notification address of this device, the chosen hour, the time zone, the language and the date of the last day played. We do not keep the child's name, grade or progress. We use this only to send at most one notification a day, and none if the child has already played. You can stop it any time: when you turn reminders off, we delete everything we kept.
